title.en: Capital structure and trading on equity
title.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ರಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಮೇಲಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ

hook.en: If you can borrow at 10% and earn 16% on it, the extra 6% is yours. That is the idea behind trading on equity — and also its danger.
hook.kn: 10% ಬಡ್ಡಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದು 16% ಗಳಿಸಿದರೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ 6% ನಿಮ್ಮದು. ಇದೇ ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಮೇಲಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದ ತತ್ವ — ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಅಪಾಯವೂ.

objectives.en: Define capital structure and financial leverage
Show trading on equity with EPS

narration.en: If you can borrow at 10% and earn 16% on it, the extra 6% is yours. That is the idea behind trading on equity — and also its danger.
narration.kn: 10% ಬಡ್ಡಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದು 16% ಗಳಿಸಿದರೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ 6% ನಿಮ್ಮದು. ಇದೇ ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಮೇಲಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದ ತತ್ವ — ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಅಪಾಯವೂ.

body.en: Capital structure is the mix of owners' funds (equity, retained earnings) and borrowed funds (debentures, loans). Debt is cheaper because interest is tax deductible and lenders bear less risk, but it raises financial risk because interest and repayment are compulsory. Financial leverage is the proportion of debt in total capital.
body.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ರಚನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾಲೀಕರ ನಿಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲದ ನಿಧಿಯ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ. ಸಾಲ ಅಗ್ಗ ಆದರೆ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಅಪಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Trading on equity

narration.en: A company needs 50 lakh and earns EBIT of 8 lakh, a return of 16 percent. Debt costs 10 percent, tax is 30 percent.

say.en: A company needs 50 lakh and earns EBIT of 8 lakh, a return of 16 percent. Debt costs 10 percent, tax is 30 percent.
Plan two pays interest of 2 lakh, so EBT is 6 lakh against 8.
After 30 percent tax: 5.6 lakh and 4.2 lakh. But plan two has only 3 lakh shares, not 5.
EPS rises from 1.12 to 1.40 rupees. Debt helped because ROI of 16 percent beats interest of 10.
Plot EPS against debt: at ROI 16 percent it rises; at ROI 8 percent it falls.

body.en: Trading on equity means using fixed-cost debt to increase the earnings per share (EPS) of equity shareholders. It is favourable only when the return on investment (ROI) is higher than the rate of interest on debt. If ROI is lower than the interest rate, EPS falls with more debt.
body.kn: ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಮೇಲಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಎಂದರೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಸಾಲ ಬಳಸಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಷೇರಿನ ಗಳಿಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವುದು. ಹೂಡಿಕೆಯ ಆದಾಯ ದರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇದು ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ.

body.en: Cash flow position, interest coverage ratio, debt service coverage ratio, return on investment, cost of debt, tax rate, cost of equity, floatation costs, risk consideration, flexibility, control, regulatory framework, stock market conditions and the capital structure of other companies in the industry.
body.kn: ನಗದು ಹರಿವಿನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ, ಬಡ್ಡಿ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಅನುಪಾತ, ಸಾಲ ಸೇವಾ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಅನುಪಾತ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆಯ ಆದಾಯ, ಸಾಲದ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ತೆರಿಗೆ ದರ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮುಂತಾದವು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ರಚನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: EPS against the amount of debt in a capital of ₹50 lakh (shares of ₹10, tax 30%). Debt raises EPS only while ROI is above the interest rate.

narration.en: Move EBIT and the interest rate and watch the EPS curve tilt up or down as more debt is used.

tryThis.en: Default values: check EPS ₹1.12 with all equity and ₹1.40 with ₹20 lakh debt.
Lower EBIT to ₹4 lakh. What happens to the curve and why?
Find the EBIT at which the curve becomes flat. Compare ROI with the interest rate there.

problem.en: A company needs ₹50 lakh and earns EBIT of ₹8 lakh (ROI 16%). Interest on debt is 10%, tax 30%, equity shares of ₹10. Compare EPS with (I) all equity and (II) ₹20 lakh debt + ₹30 lakh equity.

steps.en: (I) Interest 0; EBT ₹8 lakh; tax ₹2.4 lakh; EAT ₹5.6 lakh; shares 5 lakh; EPS = 5.6 ÷ 5 = ₹1.12.
(II) Interest = 10% of 20 = ₹2 lakh; EBT ₹6 lakh; tax ₹1.8 lakh; EAT ₹4.2 lakh; shares 3 lakh; EPS = 4.2 ÷ 3 = ₹1.40.
EPS rises because ROI (16%) is more than the cost of debt (10%): trading on equity is favourable.

answer.en: EPS ₹1.12 (all equity) vs ₹1.40 (with debt); debt raises EPS since ROI > interest rate.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A company needs ₹50 lakh and earns EBIT of ₹8 lakh (ROI 16%). Interest on debt is 10%, tax 30%, equity shares of ₹10. Compare EPS with (I) all equity and (II) ₹20 lakh debt + ₹30 lakh equity.

problem.en: Same company, but EBIT falls to ₹4 lakh (ROI 8%). Find EPS for plans (I) and (II).

steps.en: EPS is lower with debt because ROI (8%) is below the interest rate (10%).

answer.en: ₹0.56 vs about ₹0.47: trading on equity is unfavourable when ROI < cost of debt.

homework.en: Total funds ₹40 lakh, EBIT ₹6 lakh, interest 12%, tax 30%, shares of ₹10. Compare EPS for all equity and for ₹20 lakh debt.

narration.en: Recap. Capital structure is the mix of owners' and borrowed funds. Debt is cheaper but riskier. Trading on equity raises EPS only when ROI exceeds the interest rate. ICR, DSCR, tax rate, control and cash flows affect the choice.
